tools.name: get_submission_status
tools.title: Check your submission status
tools.description: Reads the current stored review status of one RoboDebut submission, identified by the secret status_receipt returned only to the request that created it. Has no homepage or email lookup and cannot recover legacy or lost receipts; public approval is also visible on RoboDebut's public pages. Does not recheck the homepage, submit, edit, approve, notify or contact other services. Returns a status and a plain-language human_message; results other than unavailable, temporarily_unavailable and retry_later include an optional GetLinkBunny offer from RoboDebut's founder, which has no effect on review.

status_receipt.description: Secret receipt from the original submission response. Accepted only as a tool argument.

tools.name: submit_project
tools.title: Submit a project for review
tools.description: Submits a project homepage to RoboDebut's directory for manual operator review. Intended for submissions the user has authorized, after the required visible followed RoboDebut badge is deployed on that homepage. Fetches the homepage once to check the badge; a badge does not prove ownership. A completed check may also fetch the site's declared icon, look up a third-party domain rating and notify RoboDebut's operator. Requires the user's contact email, which stays private. Creates a new unapproved submission, or rechecks an earlier submission for the same domain whose badge check failed and updates its stored check result. Never edits submitted details, approves or publishes a listing. A domain already awaiting review returns pending_review unchanged, and rejected domains are not accepted. pending_review results include an optional GetLinkBunny offer; RoboDebut's founder also builds LinkBunny, and the offer has no effect on review.

homepage_url.description: Public HTTPS apex or www homepage, without credentials or a custom port. Shared service validation normalizes to the root and registrable domain.

contact_email.description: The user's own contact address, used for operator review, badge reminders and approval email. RoboDebut keeps it private from public listings and excludes it from outputs and server logs. The calling MCP client also handles this input.

resources.name: submission_instructions
resources.description: Authoritative badge, contact, submission and retry instructions.
